subject: infra.energy
name: Power supply to network sites and the data centre
what_would_settle_it: An operator, utility or regulator statement quantifying outage exposure or backup provision for telecommunications sites and the Nouakchott Tier III data centre now hosting the national cloud.
disposition: partly found - SOMELEC's 2024 procurement plan includes fitting out a FADES data centre, recruitment of two telecoms engineers, and consultancy on digitalisation of the electricity utility, twenty substations in flood-prone Nouakchott zones and remote control at the national control centre. No outage-exposure or backup figure for telecommunications sites or the national data centre. Raised as an acquisition line.

subject: digital.localgov
name: Municipal or regional digital services
what_would_settle_it: A named wilaya or commune digital service, one-stop desk or local e-government platform, with a location and a start date. Ijraati and Mes Services are national portals.
disposition: not found - the nearest is the national KHIDMATY platform at khidmaty.gov.mr, which did not return readable content to automated retrieval. No municipal or wilaya digital service located; the absence stands, dated. KHIDMATY raised as a fetch-list item.

subject: tech.innovate
section: Artificial intelligence and the technology sector
name: IBTIKAR technology park
what_would_settle_it: Any dated statement of whether the IBTIKAR technology park, named in the 2023 digital agenda, was built, is operating, or holds tenants.
disposition: partly found - a 2017 FASEP-financed Atos feasibility study for a Mauritanian ICT technopole is published by the digital ministry, covering target activities, dimensioning, business plan and a preparatory governance phase. It predates and does not name IBTIKAR, and no dated status for the park was located. Raised as an acquisition line; the absence stands.

subject: capacity.literacy
name: National digital literacy measurement
what_would_settle_it: A national survey or ministry statement measuring digital skills or literacy in Mauritania, as distinct from the vocational-training place counts.
disposition: partly found - the 2021 UNDP report on creating a state digital agency (ANETA) carries a digital-readiness survey of 18 public-sector, 56 private-sector and 58 citizen respondents and records low digital literacy across administration and society, but is a perception survey rather than a measurement. Raised as an acquisition line; the measurement absence stands.
